title: The weight isn't the scary part

hook_or_overlay: Nobody's scared of the dumbbell. We're scared of walking over to get it.
audience: Women who train on machines or cardio and avoid the free-weights area
footage: Wide shot of the free-weights area; POV walk from the machines to the rack; you setting up calmly
